language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the interface. Dates, times and numbers keep their own formats.
language.label: Interface language
language.error: Failed to save. Please try again.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: How relationship rows read on a person's profile. The type always describes the other person: on Minh's profile, "em ruột Lan" means Lan is Minh's em ruột.
relationships.error: Failed to save. Please try again.

common.saveFailed: Failed to save. Please try again.

dateTime.title: Date, Time & Numbers
dateTime.description: Controls how dates, times, and numeric amounts are displayed throughout the app. The backend always stores UTC.
dateTime.timezoneHint: Used for display only. Default: UTC.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Automatically remove audit entries older than the specified number of days. Set to 0 to keep all entries.

network.title: Network Defaults
network.description: Default filter settings applied when you open the Network page. You can still change them on the fly.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: Controls how favoriting behaves on the People list. Toggling favorite status on a person's own page is always available.
favorites.allowToggle: Allow favorite/unfavorite directly on the People list

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Default rows per page for the Journal, People, and Audit lists. Applies unless a page size is set explicitly in the URL.

widgets.title: Dashboard Widgets
widgets.description: How many people to show in the Favorites and Last Contact widgets on the dashboard.

searchScope.title: Search scope
searchScope.description: Choose what the search box returns. Indexes always stay up to date — unchecking a type only hides it from results.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a theme. It applies instantly and is saved to your account.
appearance.themeError: Failed to save theme. Your previous theme was restored.

quiet-ink.label: Quiet Ink
quiet-ink.description: Clean white default with indigo accents.

warm-album.label: Warm Album
warm-album.description: Cream paper tones, serif headings, forest green.

bold-press.label: Bold Press
bold-press.description: Neobrutalist: black borders, hard shadows, punchy colors.

nightdesk.label: Nightdesk
nightdesk.description: Dark desk with amber accents and serif headings.

softclay.label: Soft Clay
softclay.description: Borderless rounded panels floating on soft shadows.

ledger.label: Ledger
ledger.description: Compact, data-dense, monospace headings, teal ink.

appearance.navLayoutDescription: Choose where the main navigation appears.
appearance.navLayoutError: Failed to save navigation layout. Your previous layout was restored.

top.label: Top bar
top.description: Navigation lives in a horizontal bar above the page content.

side.label: Side rail
side.description: Navigation lives in a vertical rail along the left edge.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.success: Password changed successfully. You may want to log out all other sessions.
changePassword.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

delete.title: Delete relationship type?
delete.description: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? Existing relationships of this type will be affected.

journalLabels.title: Journal Labels
journalLabels.empty: No labels yet. Create one to start tagging journal entries.

delete.title: Delete label?
delete.description: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? Journal entries with this label will be unaffected (label detached).

peopleLabels.title: People Labels
peopleLabels.empty: No labels yet. Create one to start categorising people.

delete.title: Delete label?
delete.description: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? People with this label will be unaffected (label detached).

calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Subscribe in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook or Thunderbird. Anyone with a URL can read these events, so keep them private.
calendar.regenerateWarning: Old URLs stop working immediately. You must re-subscribe in every calendar app.

hour.title: Notification time
hour.description: Reminders set for a whole day notify at this hour in your timezone ({{timezone}}). Reminders with a time notify at that exact time.
hour.label: Hour (0-23)
hour.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 23.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where kith sends reminder notifications. Every enabled channel receives each reminder once.
channels.noKinds: No channel types are available yet. They will show up here as they are added.
channels.unreadableHint: The stored secrets can't be decrypted, usually because the secret key changed. Re-enter them, and any custom URL, to use this channel again.

form.name: Name
form.secretKept: Leave blank to keep the saved value

ntfy.label: ntfy
ntfy.description: ntfy delivers push notifications to your phone or desktop from a topic. Use ntfy.sh or your own server. On a public server the topic name is the only access control, so pick a long random one.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: Sends through a Telegram bot. Create a bot with @BotFather, send it a message (or add it to a group), then enter its token and the chat ID.

discord.label: Discord
discord.description: Posts to a Discord channel through an incoming webhook. Create one under Channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, and paste its URL. Anyone with the URL can post, so keep it private.

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.description: Sends a signed JSON POST to your own endpoint. Each request carries X-Kith-Timestamp and X-Kith-Signature (v1=HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp, a dot, and the raw body); reject requests older than 5 minutes.

server_url.label: Server URL
server_url.hint: Leave blank for https://ntfy.sh. Changing it requires re-entering the topic and token.

topic.label: Topic
topic.hint: Letters, digits, - and _ only, up to 64 characters.

bot_token.label: Bot token
bot_token.hint: Looks like 123456:ABC-DEF. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

chat_id.label: Chat ID
chat_id.hint: A numeric ID (negative for groups) or @channelusername. Changing it requires re-entering the bot token.

api_url.label: Bot API URL
api_url.hint: Leave blank for https://api.telegram.org. Only set for a self-hosted Bot API server.

webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
webhook_url.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

url.label: Endpoint URL
url.hint: http or https, no query string. Changing it requires saving the secret again.

secret.label: Signing secret
secret.hint: Copy it now: it is stored encrypted and never shown again. Rotating it invalidates the old one at your receiver.

webpush.title: Browser push
webpush.description: Get reminders as browser notifications, no extra app needed. Each browser subscribes on its own and shows up in the channel list. On iPhone and iPad, push only works after you add kith to the Home Screen.
webpush.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. On iPhone or iPad, add kith to the Home Screen first.
webpush.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.
webpush.rotateWarning: Rotating removes every browser subscription. Each browser has to enable push again.
